summary: FD_TC_058_No Travel Origin, Uncontrollable (delay code 58, other automated system / IT), APPR
title: No Travel Origin, Uncontrollable (delay code 58, other automated system / IT), APPR
description:
A single-leg flight is delayed more than 3 hours because of delay code 58 (IT system outage, outside carrier control under APPR). The customer chooses not to travel and stays at the origin. Checks that No Travel Origin plus code 58 returns Not Eligible under APPR, with a full ticket refund entitlement.

Prerequisites:
PNR TC045: one adult passenger, one AC domestic leg YUL?YYZ, AC 460, May 28, 2026. Scheduled 10:00 ? 12:00. Actual departure 14:20 (260 min late). Actual arrival 16:25 (265 min late). No cancellation code. First arrival delay code 58 (EO). First departure delay code 58 (EO), with an incident (INC) number in the remarks. Passenger not boarded and coupon not flown. Customer stayed at YUL. No Travel status: Origin. No rebooking accepted.
